title: باب فِي مُعْجِزَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ تَبُوكَ فَأَتَيْنَا وَادِيَ الْقُرَى عَلَى حَدِيقَةٍ لاِمْرَأَةٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اخْرُصُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَصْنَاهَا وَخَرَصَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشْرَةَ أَوْسُقٍ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْصِيهَا حَتَّى نَرْجِعَ إِلَيْكِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا تَبُوكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَتَهُبُّ عَلَيْكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ رِيحٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَلاَ يَقُمْ فِيهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ فَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ بَعِيرٌ فَلْيَشُدَّ عِقَالَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَهَبَّتْ رِيحٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَحَمَلَتْهُ الرِّيحُ حَتَّى أَلْقَتْهُ بِجَبَلَىْ طَيِّئٍ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ ابْنِ الْعَلْمَاءِ صَاحِبِ أَيْلَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكِتَابٍ وَأَهْدَى لَهُ بَغْلَةً بَيْضَاءَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْدَى لَهُ بُرْدًا ثُمَّ أَقْبَلْنَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا وَادِيَ الْقُرَى فَسَأَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَرْأَةَ عَنْ حَدِيقَتِهَا ‏"‏ كَمْ بَلَغَ ثَمَرُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَشَرَةَ أَوْسُقٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي مُسْرِعٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيُسْرِعْ مَعِيَ وَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَمْكُثْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْنَا حَتَّى أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ طَابَةُ وَهَذَا أُحُدٌ وَهُوَ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ خَيْرَ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ دَارُ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَحِقَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيَّرَ دُورَ الأَنْصَارِ فَجَعَلَنَا آخِرًا ‏.‏ فَأَدْرَكَ سَعْدٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَيَّرْتَ دُورَ الأَنْصَارِ فَجَعَلْتَنَا آخِرًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَلَيْسَ بِحَسْبِكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْخِيَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab narrated to us. Sulayman ibn Bilal narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. He said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) on the expedition to Tabuk. We came to Wadi al-Qura at a woman's garden, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Estimate its produce. We estimated it, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) estimated it at ten awsuq. He said: Count it until we return to you, if Allah wills. We continued until we reached Tabuk. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A strong wind will blow upon you tonight, so none of you should stand in it. Whoever has a camel should tie its tether. A strong wind blew, and a man stood, so the wind carried him and threw him between the two mountains of Tayy. The messenger of Ibn al-Alma, the ruler of Aylah, came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) with a letter and gave him a white mule. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote back to him and gave him a cloak. We then returned until we reached Wadi al-Qura, and the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) asked the woman about her garden: How much was its produce? She said: Ten awsuq. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain. We went on until Madinah came into view. He said: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a mountain that loves us and we love it. Then he said: The best homes of the Ansar are the homes of Banu al-Najjar, then Banu Abd al-Ashhal, then Banu Abd al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj, then Banu Sa'idah, and there is good in all the homes of the Ansar. Sa'd ibn Ubadah caught up with us. Abu Usayd said: Do you not see that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) ranked the homes of the Ansar and placed us last? Sa'd caught up with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and said: Messenger of Allah, you ranked the homes of the Ansar and placed us last. He said: Is it not enough for you that you are among the best?
translation_de: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qa'nab überlieferte uns. Sulayman ibn Bilal überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya, from Abbas ibn Sahl ibn Sa'd al-Sa'idi, from Abu Humayd. Er sagte: We went out with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) on the expedition to Tabuk. We came to Wadi al-Qura at a woman's garden, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Estimate its produce. We estimated it, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) estimated it at ten awsuq. Er sagte: Count it until we return to you, if Allah wills. We continued until we reached Tabuk. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A strong wind will blow upon you tonight, so none of you should stand in it. Whoever has a camel should tie its tether. A strong wind blew, and a man stood, so the wind carried him and threw him between the two Bergs of Tayy. The messenger of Ibn al-Alma, the ruler of Aylah, came to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) with a letter and gave him a white mule. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote back to him and gave him a cloak. We then returned until we reached Wadi al-Qura, and der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) asked the woman about her garden: How much was its produce? She said: Ten awsuq. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am going ahead quickly. Whoever wishes may go quickly with me, and whoever wishes may remain. We went on until Medina came into view. Er sagte: This is Tabah, and this is Uhud, a Berg that loves us and we love it. Then he said: The best homes of the Ansar are the homes of Banu al-Najjar, then Banu Abd al-Ashhal, then Banu Abd al-Harith ibn al-Khazraj, then Banu Sa'idah, and there is good in all the homes of the Ansar. Sa'd ibn Ubadah caught up with us. Abu Usayd said: Do you not see that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) ranked the homes of the Ansar and placed us last? Sa'd caught up with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) and said: Messenger of Allah, you ranked the homes of the Ansar and placed us last. Er sagte: Is it not enough for you that you are among the best? Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فِي مُعْجِزَاتِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ مِنْ قِصَّةِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ وُهَيْبٍ فَكَتَبَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبَحْرِهِمْ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ وُهَيْبٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Affan narrated to us. H; Ishaq ibn Ibrahim informed us. al-Mughirah ibn Salamah al-Makhzumi narrated to us. They both said: Wuhaib narrated to us, from Amr ibn Yahya, with this chain up to the words: There is good in all the homes of the Ansar. It did not mention what followed concerning Sa'd ibn Ubadah. Wuhaib's narration adds: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote to him concerning their sea. It does not say in Wuhaib's narration that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote to him.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Affan überlieferte uns. H; Ishaq ibn Ibrahim berichtete uns. al-Mughirah ibn Salamah al-Makhzumi überlieferte uns. They both said: Wuhaib überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Yahya, with this chain up to the words: There is good in all the homes of the Ansar. It did not mention what followed concerning Sa'd ibn Ubadah. Wuhaib's narration adds: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) wrote to him concerning their sea. It does not say in Wuhaib's narration that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) wrote to him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1393 a, book 15, باب أُحُدٌ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏‏
title: باب أُحُدٌ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ، بْنُ مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أُحُدًا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Qurrat ibn Khalid narrated to us, from Qatadah. Anas ibn Malik narrated to us. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Uhud is a mountain that loves us and we love it.
translation_de: Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Qurrat ibn Khalid überlieferte uns, from Qatadah. Anas ibn Malik überlieferte uns. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Uhud is a Berg that loves us and we love it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1393 b, book 15, باب أُحُدٌ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏‏
title: باب أُحُدٌ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا قُرَّةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ نَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أُحُدًا جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri narrated it to me. Harami ibn Umarah narrated to me. Qurrat narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Anas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) looked at Uhud and said: Uhud is a mountain that loves us and we love it.
translation_de: Ubayd Allah ibn Umar al-Qawariri narrated it to me. Harami ibn Umarah überlieferte mir. Qurrat überlieferte uns, from Qatadah, from Anas. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) looked at Uhud and said: Uhud is a Berg that loves us and we love it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1394 a, book 15, باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me, and Amr's wording is used. They said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers elsewhere, except the Sacred Mosque.
translation_de: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir, and Amr's wording is used. They said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets elsewhere, except the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1394 b, book 15, باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ فِي غَيْرِهِ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلاَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me. Abd said: He informed us, and Ibn Rafi said: Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers in other mosques, except the Sacred Mosque.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Rafi and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte mir. Abd said: He berichtete uns, and Ibn Rafi said: Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets in other Moschees, except the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ الْحِمْصِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَغَرِّ، مَوْلَى الْجُهَنِيِّينَ - وَكَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ - أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلاَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم آخِرُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَإِنَّ مَسْجِدَهُ آخِرُ الْمَسَاجِدِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَأَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ لَمْ نَشُكَّ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ كَانَ يَقُولُ عَنْ حَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَنَعَنَا ذَلِكَ أَنْ نَسْتَثْبِتَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ الْحَدِيثِ حَتَّى إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ تَذَاكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ وَتَلاَوَمْنَا أَنْ لاَ نَكُونَ كَلَّمْنَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يُسْنِدَهُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنْ كَانَ سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُ فَبَيْنَا نَحْنُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ جَالَسَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ قَارِظٍ فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ الْحَدِيثَ وَالَّذِي فَرَّطْنَا فِيهِ مِنْ نَصِّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ لَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِنِّي آخِرُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ وَإِنَّ مَسْجِدِي آخِرُ الْمَسَاجِدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me. Isa ibn al-Mundhir al-Himsi narrated to us. Muhammad ibn Harb narrated to us. al-Zubaydi narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Abu Abd Allah al-Aghar, the freedman of the Juhaynah, who were both companions of Abu Hurayra. They heard Abu Hurayra say: Prayer in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is better than one thousand prayers in other mosques, except the Sacred Mosque. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is the last of the prophets, and his mosque is the last of the mosques. Abu Salamah and Abu Abd Allah said: We had no doubt that Abu Hurayra was relating it from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), but we did not ask him to confirm it until Abu Hurayra died. Then we discussed it and regretted not asking him to attribute it to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), if he had heard it from him. While we were in that state, Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz sat with us and said: I testify that I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the last of the prophets and my mosque is the last of the mosques.
translation_de: Ishaq ibn Mansur überlieferte mir. Isa ibn al-Mundhir al-Himsi überlieferte uns. Muhammad ibn Harb überlieferte uns. al-Zubaydi überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Abu Abd Allah al-Aghar, the freedman of the Juhaynah, who were both companions of Abu Hurayra. They heard Abu Hurayra say: Prayer in the Moschee of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) is better than one thousand Gebets in other Moschees, except the Heilig Mosque. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) is the last of the prophets, and his Moschee is the last of the Moschees. Abu Salamah and Abu Abd Allah said: We had no doubt that Abu Hurayra was relating it from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), but we did not ask him to confirm it until Abu Hurayra died. Then we discussed it and regretted not asking him to attribute it to der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), if he had heard it from him. While we were in that state, Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz sat with us and said: I testify that I heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: I am the last of the prophets and my Moschee is the last of the Moschees. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، - قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَذْكُرُ فَضْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لاَ وَلَكِنْ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ قَارِظٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ - أَوْ كَأَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ - فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ ‏"‏ ‏.
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us, both from al-Thaqafi. Ibn al-Muthanna said: Abd al-Wahhab narrated to us. He said: I heard Yahya ibn Sa'id say: I asked Abu Salih whether he had heard Abu Hurayra mention the virtue of prayer in the mosque of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He said: No, but Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz informed me that he heard Abu Hurayra relate that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers, or like one thousand prayers, in other mosques, except if it is the Sacred Mosque.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns, both from al-Thaqafi. Ibn al-Muthanna said: Abd al-Wahhab überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I heard Yahya ibn Sa'id say: I asked Abu Salih whether he had heard Abu Hurayra mention the virtue of Gebet in the Moschee of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Er sagte: No, but Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim ibn Qariz berichtete mir that he heard Abu Hurayra relate that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets, or like one thousand Gebets, in other Moschees, except if it is the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، الْقَطَّانُ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, and Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated it to me. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb, Ubayd Allah ibn Sa'id, and Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated it to me. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Yahya ibn Sa'id, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِي هَذَا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الْحَرَامَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Prayer in this mosque of mine is better than one thousand prayers elsewhere, except the Sacred Mosque.
translation_de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi berichtete mir, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Prayer in this Moschee of mine is better than one thousand Gebets elsewhere, except the Heilig Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibrahim ibn Musa narrated to me. Ibn Abi Za'idah informed us, from Musa al-Juhani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say the same.
translation_de: Ibrahim ibn Musa überlieferte mir. Ibn Abi Za'idah berichtete uns, from Musa al-Juhani, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ بِمَسْجِدَىْ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، - عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ امْرَأَةً اشْتَكَتْ شَكْوَى فَقَالَتْ إِنْ شَفَانِي اللَّهُ لأَخْرُجَنَّ فَلأُصَلِّيَنَّ فِي بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ ‏.‏ فَبَرَأَتْ ثُمَّ تَجَهَّزَتْ تُرِيدُ الْخُرُوجَ فَجَاءَتْ مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهَا فَأَخْبَرَتْهَا ذَلِكَ فَقَالَتِ اجْلِسِي فَكُلِي مَا صَنَعْتِ وَصَلِّي فِي مَسْجِدِ الرَّسُولِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ صَلاَةٌ فِيهِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ أَلْفِ صَلاَةٍ فِيمَا سِوَاهُ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ إِلاَّ مَسْجِدَ الْكَعْبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Rumh narrated to us, both from al-Layth ibn Sa'd. Qutaybah said: Layth narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibrahim ibn Abd Allah ibn Ma'bad, from Ibn Abbas. He said: A woman became ill and said: If Allah heals me, I will go out and pray in Bayt al-Maqdis. She recovered and prepared to leave. Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), came to greet her, and she told her this. Maymunah said: Sit and eat what you prepared, and pray in the mosque of the Messenger (peace be upon him), for I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Prayer in it is better than one thousand prayers in other mosques, except the mosque of the Ka'bah.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn Rumh überlieferte uns, both from al-Layth ibn Sa'd. Qutaybah said: Layth überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibrahim ibn Abd Allah ibn Ma'bad, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: A woman became ill and said: If Allah heals me, I will go out and pray in Bayt al-Maqdis. She recovered and prepared to leave. Maymunah, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), came to greet her, and she told her this. Maymunah said: Sit and eat what you prepared, and pray in the Moschee of the Messenger (peace be upon him), for I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Prayer in it is better than one thousand Gebets in other Moschees, except the Moschee of the Ka'bah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1397 a, book 15, باب لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏‏
title: باب لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ مَسْجِدِي هَذَا وَمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَمَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, both from Ibn Uyaynah. Amr said: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Journeys should not be undertaken except to three mosques: this mosque of mine, the Sacred Mosque, and al-Aqsa Mosque.
translation_de: Amr al-Naqid and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, both from Ibn Uyaynah. Amr said: Sufyan überlieferte uns, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Journeys should not be undertaken except to three Moschees: this Moschee of mine, the Heilig Mosque, and al-Aqsa Mosque. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1397 b, book 15, باب لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏‏
title: باب لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd al-Ala narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, with this chain, except that he said: Journeys are undertaken to three mosques.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, with this chain, except that he said: Journeys are undertaken to three Moschees. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1397 c, book 15, باب لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏‏
title: باب لاَ تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلاَّ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَنَّ عِمْرَانَ بْنَ أَبِي أَنَسٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ سَلْمَانَ الأَغَرَّ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يُخْبِرُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يُسَافَرُ إِلَى ثَلاَثَةِ مَسَاجِدَ مَسْجِدِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَمَسْجِدِي وَمَسْجِدِ إِيلِيَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to us. Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far narrated to me that Imran ibn Abi Anas narrated to him that Salman al-Aghar narrated to him that he heard Abu Hurayra report that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Travel is undertaken only to three mosques: the mosque of the Ka'bah, my mosque, and the mosque of Iliya.
translation_de: Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte uns. Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Abd al-Hamid ibn Ja'far überlieferte mir that Imran ibn Abi Anas narrated to him that Salman al-Aghar narrated to him that he heard Abu Hurayra report that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Travel is undertaken only to three Moschees: the Moschee of the Ka'bah, my Moschee, and the Moschee of Iliya. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1398 a, book 15, باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى هُوَ مَسْجِدُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ
title: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى هُوَ مَسْجِدُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْخَرَّاطِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ مَرَّ بِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ كَيْفَ سَمِعْتَ أَبَاكَ يَذْكُرُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى قَالَ قَالَ أَبِي دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِ بَعْضِ نِسَائِهِ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الْمَسْجِدَيْنِ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى قَالَ فَأَخَذَ كَفًّا مِنْ حَصْبَاءَ فَضَرَبَ بِهِ الأَرْضَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ مَسْجِدُكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ - لِمَسْجِدِ الْمَدِينَةِ - قَالَ فَقُلْتُ أَشْهَدُ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ أَبَاكَ هَكَذَا يَذْكُرُهُ ‏.
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Humayd al-Kharrat. He said: I heard Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id al-Khudri passed by me. I asked him: How did you hear your father speak about the mosque founded upon piety? He said: My father said: I entered upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) in the house of one of his wives and asked: Messenger of Allah, which of the two mosques is the one founded upon piety? He took a handful of pebbles, struck the ground with them, and said: This is your mosque, meaning the mosque of Madinah. I said: I testify that I heard your father say this.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Humayd al-Kharrat. Er sagte: I heard Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman say: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id al-Khudri passed by me. I asked him: How did you hear your father speak about the Moschee founded upon piety? Er sagte: My father said: I entered upon der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) in the house of one of his wives and asked: Messenger of Allah, which of the two Moschees is the one founded upon piety? He took a handful of pebbles, struck the ground with them, and said: This is your Moschee, meaning the Moschee of Medina. I said: I testify that I heard your father say this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1398 b, book 15, باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى هُوَ مَسْجِدُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ
title: باب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الْمَسْجِدَ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى هُوَ مَسْجِدُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، قَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ فِي الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi narrated to us. Sa'id said: He informed us, and Abu Bakr said: Hatim ibn Ismail narrated to us, from Humayd, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Sa'id, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same meaning. It does not mention Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id in the chain.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Sa'id ibn Amr al-Ash'athi überlieferte uns. Sa'id said: He berichtete uns, and Abu Bakr said: Hatim ibn Ismail überlieferte uns, from Humayd, from Abu Salamah, from Abu Sa'id, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same meaning. It does not mention Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Sa'id in the chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1399 a, book 15, باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَزُورُ قُبَاءً رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Mani narrated to us. Ismail ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Ayyub narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to visit Quba riding and walking.
translation_de: Abu Ja'far Ahmad ibn Mani überlieferte uns. Ismail ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Ayyub überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to visit Quba riding and zu Fuß. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1399 b, book 15, باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِي مَسْجِدَ قُبَاءٍ رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا فَيُصَلِّي فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فَيُصَلِّي فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ‏.
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. H; Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to the mosque of Quba riding and walking and pray two units there. Abu Bakr's narration says: Ibn Numayr said: He prayed two units there.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. H; Muhammad ibn Abd Allah ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to the Moschee of Quba riding and zu Fuß and pray two units there. Abu Bakr's narration says: Ibn Numayr said: He prayed two units there. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1399 c, book 15, باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْتِي قُبَاءً رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Yahya narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us. Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba riding and walking.
translation_de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Yahya überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns. Nafi berichtete mir, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to come to Quba riding and zu Fuß. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1399 d, book 15, باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، زَيْدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الثَّقَفِيُّ - بَصْرِيٌّ ثِقَةٌ - حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ ‏.
translation_en: Abu Ma'n al-Raqashi, Zayd ibn Yazid al-Thaqafi, a trustworthy Basran, narrated to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us, from Ibn Ajlan, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), with the same as Yahya al-Qattan's hadith.
translation_de: Abu Ma'n al-Raqashi, Zayd ibn Yazid al-Thaqafi, a trustworthy Basran, überlieferte mir. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns, from Ibn Ajlan, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), with the same as Yahya al-Qattan's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1399 e, book 15, باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْتِي قُبَاءً رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba riding and walking.

title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ، عُمَرَ كَانَ يَأْتِي قُبَاءً كُلَّ سَبْتٍ وَكَانَ يَقُولُ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْتِيهِ كُلَّ سَبْتٍ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, that Ibn Umar used to come to Quba every Saturday and say: I saw the Prophet (peace be upon him) come to it every Saturday.

title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْتِي قُبَاءً يَعْنِي كُلَّ سَبْتٍ كَانَ يَأْتِيهِ رَاكِبًا وَمَاشِيًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ دِينَارٍ وَكَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ يَفْعَلُهُ ‏.‏
translation_en: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to come to Quba, meaning every Saturday, riding and walking. Ibn Dinar said: Ibn Umar used to do this.
translation_de: Ibn Abi Umar narrated it to us. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Abd Allah ibn Dinar, from Abd Allah ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) used to come to Quba, meaning every Saturday, riding and zu Fuß. Ibn Dinar said: Ibn Umar used to do this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب فَضْلِ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءٍ وَفَضْلِ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ وَزِيَارَتِهِ ‏‏

translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Hashim narrated it to me. Waki narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Ibn Dinar, with this chain. He did not mention every Saturday.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ النِّكَاحِ لِمَنْ تَاقَتْ نَفْسُهُ إِلَيْهِ وَوَجَدَ مُؤْنَةً وَاشْتِغَالِ مَنْ عَجَزَ عَنِ الْمُؤَنِ بِالصَّوْمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمْشِي مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِمِنًى فَلَقِيَهُ عُثْمَانُ فَقَامَ مَعَهُ يُحَدِّثُهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَلاَ نُزَوِّجُكَ جَارِيَةً شَابَّةً لَعَلَّهَا تُذَكِّرُكَ بَعْضَ مَا مَضَى مِنْ زَمَانِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَاكَ لَقَدْ قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا مَعْشَرَ الشَّبَابِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمُ الْبَاءَةَ فَلْيَتَزَوَّجْ فَإِنَّهُ أَغَضُّ لِلْبَصَرِ وَأَحْصَنُ لِلْفَرْجِ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَعَلَيْهِ بِالصَّوْمِ فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ وِجَاءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani narrated to us, all from Abu Muawiyah. Yahya's wording is used. He informed us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah. He said: I was walking with Abd Allah at Mina when Uthman met him. He stood with him and spoke to him. Uthman said: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not marry you to a young girl, perhaps she would remind you of some of what has passed from your life? Abd Allah said: If you say that, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to us: Young men, whoever among you can afford marriage should marry, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding the private parts. Whoever cannot afford it should fast, for fasting is a protection for him.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya al-Tamimi, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Muhammad ibn al-Ala al-Hamdani überlieferte uns, all from Abu Muawiyah. Yahya's wording is used. He berichtete uns, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah. Er sagte: I was zu Fuß with Abd Allah at Mina when Uthman met him. He stood with him and spoke to him. Uthman said: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not heiraten you to a jungen girl, perhaps she would remind you of some of what has passed from your life? Abd Allah said: If you say that, der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said to us: Young men, whoever among you can afford marriage should heiraten, for it is more effective in lowering the gaze and guarding the private parts. Whoever cannot afford it should fast, for Fasten is a protection for him. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

title: باب اسْتِحْبَابِ النِّكَاحِ لِمَنْ تَاقَتْ نَفْسُهُ إِلَيْهِ وَوَجَدَ مُؤْنَةً وَاشْتِغَالِ مَنْ عَجَزَ عَنِ الْمُؤَنِ بِالصَّوْمِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، قَالَ إِنِّي لأَمْشِي مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ بِمِنًى إِذْ لَقِيَهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ فَقَالَ هَلُمَّ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ فَاسْتَخْلاَهُ فَلَمَّا رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَنْ لَيْسَتْ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ - قَالَ - قَالَ لِي تَعَالَ يَا عَلْقَمَةُ - قَالَ - فَجِئْتُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُثْمَانُ أَلاَ نُزَوِّجُكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ جَارِيَةً بِكْرًا لَعَلَّهُ يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْكَ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ مَا كُنْتَ تَعْهَدُ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏
translation_en: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Jarir narrated to us, from al-Amash, from Ibrahim, from Alqamah. He said: I was walking with Abd Allah ibn Masud at Mina when Uthman ibn Affan met him and said: Come, Abu Abd al-Rahman. He took him aside, and when Abd Allah saw that he had no need of him, he said to me: Come, Alqamah. I came, and Uthman said to him: Abu Abd al-Rahman, should we not marry you to a young virgin, perhaps she would bring back to you some of what you used to have? Abd Allah said: If you say that. Then he mentioned the same as Abu Muawiyah's hadith.

Er sagte: I was zu Fuß with Abd Allah ibn Masud at Mina when Uthman ibn Affan met him and said: Come, Abu Abd al-Rahman. He took him aside, and when Abd Allah saw that he had no need of him, he said to me: Come, Alqamah. Then he mentioned the same as Abu Muawiyah's hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
